name: Opening-drive continuation
hypothesis: If the first 15 minutes cover at least 0.3 daily ATR and close in the top 20% of their range, the drive tends to continue.

entry.long: bar_in_session() == 2 and opening_range(15).high - opening_range(15).low > 0.3*tf("1d", atr(14)) and close > opening_range(15).high - 0.2*(opening_range(15).high - opening_range(15).low)
entry.short: bar_in_session() == 2 and opening_range(15).high - opening_range(15).low > 0.3*tf("1d", atr(14)) and close < opening_range(15).low + 0.2*(opening_range(15).high - opening_range(15).low)
